description: INK for All was an AI writing assistant for SEO. It scored content, helped draft posts and outlines, and checked plagiarism and accessibility. On 21 October 2026, inkforall.com no longer opened this product. It led to the SmythOS Runtime Environment, which is a different product. The tool is closed.

AI Writer: Assists with blog writing, content generation, and outlines.
